_what: Source of truth for image_text_match: a CLIP-like toy. Does a one-word caption describe a 3x3 one-bit image? train.py fits kernels, text embedding table and threshold to the labels; golden.py and the RTL implement the structure, widths and stream behaviour below.

stream.input: 10 beats, one item per beat in s_data[7:0], s_last on the 10th: beats 0..8 = pixels (raster order, value 0/1, bit s_data[0]), beat 9 = caption token (0..3)
stream.output: two beats: beat 0 = {6'b0, error, class}, beat 1 = similarity score (8-bit two's complement), m_last on beat 1
stream.error: a pixel beat above 1 or a token beat above 3 (the item is not used: pixel left 0 / token left 0 = EMPTY), a beat past the 10th (ignored), or a frame whose length is not exactly 10 (missing items are 0)
stream.latency: clock edges from the edge that accepts the last input beat to the edge that raises m_valid, counting both: 1 (accept) + 8 (one line per cycle) + 1 (similarity) = 10

labels.VERT: 1 when some column (pixels 0,3,6 / 1,4,7 / 2,5,8) is fully lit
labels.HORIZ: 1 when some row (pixels 0,1,2 / 3,4,5 / 6,7,8) is fully lit
labels.DIAG: 1 when a diagonal (pixels 0,4,8 or 2,4,6) is fully lit

lines._note: 8 lines of 3 pixels, scanned one per cycle by the SAME two neurons; pixel i of a line is kernel tap i. group = channel pool: cols 0-2, rows 3-5, diags 6-7

model.image_encoder: two 3-tap binary neurons (A, B), each: match = number of line pixels equal to their 1-bit kernel weight (0..3); fire = match >= neuron threshold. Each neuron is reused over the 8 lines; fires are SUM-pooled per line group into small counts: embedding = 6 counts (A cols, A rows, A diags, B cols, B rows, B diags), each 0..3
model.text_encoder: ROM: caption token -> 6 signed 3-bit integers in the SAME 6-dimensional space (range -4..3)
model.similarity: dot product of the 6 counts with the 6 text weights (7-bit signed, trained so |score| <= 63); class = score >= threshold

search.order: kernel pairs ascending by (cost, A, B); first exact wins; then smallest threshold; then per caption smallest sum |w| then lexicographic. Deterministic, no randomness (seed recorded for completeness)
